audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill/Skill/Skill/Olaf/Skill/Olaf/Olaf, contradicting the packet chart and their own adjacent whys on five of seven rows; diff was FAV at 7/10.
audit.why: The whys already describe the packet order — Olaf owns levels 1-2 and level 6, Sett owns 3-5 and both item stages. The mirror (olaf__sett) settled diff EVEN at 6/10 over a 52.58% win rate.
audit.corrected: All seven rows set to Olaf, Olaf, Sett, Sett, Olaf, Sett, Sett as matched pairs with ratings; diff, diffRating, tone and the two difficulty strings moved to EVEN 6/10 together.

audit.why: Spike timings match the corrected chart: level 3 Facebreaker window, level 6 Ragnarok swing, first-item reclaim, late-game Grit sustain. Only the level-6 wording needed fixing, not the timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ragnarok described as flat CC immunity that also makes him un-slowable — repeated in five places.
audit.why: Riot's text: he becomes immune to disables FOR AS LONG AS HE KEEPS ATTACKING. That is a conditional the player can play around (break his attack target, or wait the window), and nothing in the text grants slow immunity.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, spikes[1], whys[4], mid and wants.foe[2] all restate the attacking condition and drop the un-slowable claim.

audit.whatIsWrong: Reckless Swing was never mentioned, and dosFull[2].d repeated an unrelated Ragnarok line under the heading 'Walk over his axe to deny it'.
audit.why: Reckless Swing (E, 325 range, 11/10/9/8/7s) is true damage that also costs Olaf health — and every point of it he lands on you is stored as Grit for Haymaker's true-damage centre.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d now states the Grit conversion.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 7/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Ragnarok and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Ragnarok and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 7/10, Olaf carry threat 8/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 6/10, Olaf carry threat 8/10.

edits.before: - Olaf Ragnarok: matchup-defining — CC-immune — your E-stun won’t hold him. Bait it. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Olaf Ragnarok (R, 100s at rank 1): he ignores disables only while he keeps attacking. Break off, then E-stun.

edits.before: CC-immune — your E-stun won’t hold him. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: He ignores disables while he keeps attacking — engage once Ragnarok is down or baited.

edits.before: Olaf wastes Ragnarok — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Reckless Swing costs him health and fills your Grit bar.

edits.before: Track Olaf's Ragnarok: CC-immune — your E-stun won’t hold him. Bait it. When it is down — E-stun + W him.
edits.after: Track Olaf's Ragnarok: disables are ignored only while he keeps swinging. When it is down — E-stun + W him.

edits.before: Olaf reclaims Level 6 because R Ragnarok makes him CC-immune, negating Sett's displacement.
edits.after: Olaf reclaims Level 6 — Ragnarok ignores your stun for as long as he keeps swinging.

edits.before: Careful — Level 6 swings to Olaf: his R Ragnarok makes him CC-immune, so The Show Stopper won't displace him mid-ult; hold R to slam him before he presses it, not after.
edits.after: Careful — Level 6 swings to Olaf: Ragnarok (100s at rank 1) ignores disables while he keeps attacking, so slam him with The Show Stopper before he presses it, not after.

edits.before: You claw the lane back from Level 3: E Facebreaker pins him for a Q-Haymaker and Grit sustain lets you outlast his DPS — except at Level 6, where R Ragnarok makes him CC-immune and un-slowable, so your displacement whiffs. Fight him when his ult and Q are down and you win the exchange.
edits.after: You claw the lane back from Level 3: Facebreaker stuns only with enemies on both sides, so pull him across your wave for a Q-Haymaker. At Level 6 Ragnarok ignores your disables while he keeps attacking — wait that window out, then fight once his ult and Q are down.

edits.before: Press R Ragnarok to become CC-immune and true-damage you
edits.after: Press Ragnarok and keep swinging to ignore your stun

notes: Undertow carries a 'grounding' derived flag, but Riot's text only says it reduces armour and move speed — no dash-block is stated, and whether it would stop The Show Stopper is unverifiable from the kit, so nothing on the page asserts it (the mirror left it unstated for the same reason). tone was moved to #e8b84b to match the other EVEN pages in this champion's data (mordekaiser, nautilus); if the palette token for EVEN is different, this one hex is the thing to check.
